notes.note: The affected link-intake, explicit grant and selected-owner claims remain accurate. Connection steps are fixed local literals for saved-profile, station-trust, grant-status, host-redemption and grant-refresh, assigned across existing awaits without changing their order or guards. Local codes are fixed outputs selected only by exact matching of existing rejection strings; unknown Error messages or primitive values expose step only. The optional routing enum still comes from strict redeemLinked parsing; no raw errors, URLs, bodies, SDP, proofs, credentials or owner IDs enter the disclosure. Per-attempt clearing, active-review guards, pendingId remount, cancellation, expiry and no-retry behavior remain unchanged. grant-refresh is set after validated redemption/confirmed-handle callback and redeemed=true; a secondary refresh failure retains the accepted grant and Device progression rather than undoing success. Existing generic alert text remains shared with that secondary failure, while the fixed step distinguishes it. These observations locate local code boundaries, not the live broker or host’s original failure cause.
